n, m, p = map(int, input().split())

def mypow(a, b):
    ans = 1
    while b > 0:
        if b & 1:
            ans = (ans * a) % p
        a = (a * a) % p
        b >>= 1
    return ans

def C(n, m):
    return (fac[n] * invfac[m] % p) * invfac[n - m] % p

def sum_x(x):
    return (x * (x + 1) // 2) % p

fac = [1] * 501
for i in range(1, 501):
    fac[i] = (fac[i - 1] * i) % p

invfac = [1] * 501
invfac[500] = mypow(fac[500], p - 2)
for i in range(499, -1, -1):
    invfac[i] = (invfac[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % p

cnt = [0] * 505
dp = [0] * 505
dp[0] = 0
cnt[0] = 1
cnt[1] = 2
dp[1] = 0

for i in range(2, m + 1):
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        zh = C(i - 1, j - 1)
        tmp = (cnt[j - 1] * cnt[i - j] % p) * zh % p
        dp[i] = (dp[i] + tmp * sum_x(j - 1) + zh * j % p * (dp[j - 1] * cnt[i - j] % p + dp[i - j] * cnt[j - 1] % p)) % p
        cnt[i] = (cnt[i] + tmp * j) % p
        dp[i] = (dp[i] + tmp * sum_x(i - j) + zh * (i - j + 1) % p * (dp[j - 1] * cnt[i - j] % p + dp[i - j] * cnt[j - 1] % p)) % p
        cnt[i] = (cnt[i] + tmp * (i - j + 1)) % p

dp2 = [[0] * 505 for _ in range(505)]
tot = [[0] * 505 for _ in range(505)]
dp2[0][0] = 0
tot[0][0] = 1

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(0, min(m, i) + 1):
        dp2[i][j] = dp2[i - 1][j]
        tot[i][j] = tot[i - 1][j]
        for k in range(1, j + 1):
            if k < i:
                zh = C(j, k)
                dp2[i][j] = (dp2[i][j] + dp[k] * zh % p * tot[i - k - 1][j - k] % p + dp2[i - k - 1][j - k] * zh % p * cnt[k]) % p
                tot[i][j] = (tot[i][j] + cnt[k] * tot[i - k - 1][j - k] % p * zh) % p
            else:
                dp2[i][j] = (dp2[i][j] + dp[i]) % p
                tot[i][j] = (tot[i][j] + cnt[i]) % p

print(dp2[n][m])
